note: Fictional scam and legitimate messages for testing Second Look. Every name, number and link is made up (555 numbers, invented websites). Modeled on scam types the FTC and AARP describe. 'expect' lists the verdicts we would accept. 'profile' is 'margaret' (Wells Fargo, Kaiser Permanente, PG&E, AT&T; checking, savings, credit card) or 'none'.
